name: American Territory
en:
* Likely impossible with changes to diplomatic interests in patch 1.13.
* Forming {{flag|Turtle Island}} does not block this achievement.

- id=\"An Empire Under the Pun\"

name: An Empire Under the Pun
en:
* Forming {{flag|India}} or other countries does not invalidate the achievement, but switching to another country by releasing them does
{{collapse list|It is not possible to make {{flag|Great Britain}} a subject while they are a great power or a major power, thus you will need to weaken them in one or more wars first.|
* In order to survive the early game, becoming a subject of a great power, such as {{flag|France}}, can be very helpful, both for economic expansion and military support. However, keep in mind that autonomous subjects are not automatically supported by their overlord when initiating a diplo play and the overlord may need to be swayed.
* Expanding westward into {{flag|Persia}} and other Central Asian countries and eastward into South East Asia are good ways to build strength before taking on Great Britain and the {{flag|East India}} (EIC). However, with France or another great power's support, it should be possible to take states from the EIC or Great Britain earlier.
* It is very likely the player will need to conquer most of the British Isles (or release countries such as {{flag|Ireland}} and {{flag|Scotland}}) in order to weaken Great Britain sufficiently to drop them to a minor power, as well as liberating or transferring their large subjects such as East India, {{flag|Canada}}, {{flag|Australia}}, and {{flag|South Africa}}. Be prepared to reach [[File:Infamy pariah.png|link=|Pariah|24px]] Pariah status while attempting this, leaving the player potentially vulnerable to a {{iconify|Cut Down to Size|image=wargoal contain threat.png|4=nosp}} war.}}

- id=\"Anarchy in the UK\"

name: Anarchy in the UK
en:
No IG's will support anarchy by default, so an {{ideology|anarchist}} character as IG leader or a strong anarchist movement is required. For anarchist characters to appear the {{technology|Anarchism}} technology is required. The most likely IG's are either Trade Unions or Intelligentsia, so making them powerful is key.

- id=\"Barbary’s Back\"

name: Barbary’s Back
en:
* {{iconify|Unrecognized Major Power}} is not enough. The country must be recognized to gain the achievement.
* Despite being listed as a medium difficulty achievement, this achievement is quite difficult, as in order to form Algeria, one has to win a war against {{flag|France}}, otherwise they will not fully control the three states necessary to form Algeria.
* {{flag|Mascara}} is in the strongest position at game start, having the largest population, largest economy, and best starting laws.

- id=\"Belle Époque\"

name: Belle Époque
en:
* The name of the achievement is French for \"Beautiful Era\", and is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belle_Époque description of the time from 1871 to 1914].
* Highest innovation is a simple matter of having the most universities in the world, while maintaining a relatively high literacy rate.

- id=\"Billionaire\"

name: Billionaire
en: - id=\"Bourbon for Everyone!\"

name: Bourbon for Everyone!
en:
{{collapse list|Cannot be achieved if starting as {{flag|Carlist Spain}}, but is no longer blocked by forming {{flag|Iberia}}.
Raising average standard of living requires increasing pop wages and reducing consumption goods costs.|
* Lower strata pops have lower wages, particularly {{icon|peasants|3=1}}, so it's very important to fully employ pops in buildings and not leave any subsistence farms.
* Conquering or colonizing more states increases the number of pops whose standard of living must be raised, so expanding your market through subjects or diplomacy is preferable. Releasing states with low standard of living as subjects can be an effective way to boost the average standard of living.
* Remember that government and military employees are pops, too; you can set their pay to the max to increase their wages and thus standard of living.
* See [[Spain#Strategy]] for more tips}}

- id=\"Broken Promises\"

name: Broken Promises
en:
* You need to go against two actual allies (defensive pacts do not count), therefore {{technology|Multilateral Alliances|text=link}} society technology is required
{{collapse list|You cannot oppose the initiator or target of a play if they are your ally. You need to be allies with two countries that are secondary participants of the play on the same side, then join the other side.|You can form the alliances after joining the play. Being on the same side of a play gives a +1000 bonus to attitude, setting it to Genial, allowing you to easily make alliances with other members of your side of the play, as long as you have +80 (Friendly) relations or +50 (Amicable) relations and much larger power projection score. Build a large navy to get diplomatic interests over the entire world, so you can participate in all diplomatic plays. Raise relations with every minor country in the game to +50 and to +80 with the Great Powers. Watch every diplomatic play for the opportunity to make two alliances with secondary participants on one side.}}

The achievement may be a reference to Italy joining the Triple Entente in 1915 despite being a member of the Triple Alliance with Germany and Austria-Hungary.

- id=\"Caretaker\"

name: Caretaker
en:
{{collapse list|The final objective requires having less than 10% of your population as peasants, an average standard of living of at least 20 and a literacy rate of at least 90%, after enacting (and keeping) the following laws:|
** ''{{law|Protected Speech}}''
** ''{{law|Public Schools}}''
** ''{{law|Multiculturalism}}''
** ''{{law|Compulsory Primary School}}''
** ''{{law|Women's Suffrage}}''
** {{red|Not}} ''{{law|State Religion}}''

If you are having difficulty raising literacy to 90%, you likely have so much migration that you are bringing illiterate pops into your country faster than you can educate them. Passing {{law|Closed Borders}} should resolve this issue.}}

- id=\"Deeds, not words!\"

name: Deeds, not words!
en:
You need to discover {{technology|Feminism|text=link}} society technology in order for leaders to have Feminist ideology. Otherwise, you will not have any party's support in passing the {{law|Women's Suffrage|text=link}} law.

- id=\"Educated\"

name: Educated
en:
{{collapse list|Required sub-goals to complete|
** Expand a basic [[Building]]
** Change [[Production Method]]
** Expand a Productive Building
** Establish a [[Trade Route]]
** Improve Access to Consumer Goods
** Bolster an [[Interest Group]]
** Passing an [[Institution|Institutional Law]] ''OR'' Reform the Government
** Increase [[Relations]] 
** Declare an [[Interest]]
** Create Formation
** Expand the Military
** Recruit and Promote a [[Commander]]
** Start Diplomatic Play
** Mobilize an Army
** Send General to the Front
** Make Peace
** Solidifying our Position
}}
A subgoal only counts if it is completed while it is present in the [[journal]]. Note that ''Solidifying our Position'' has three distinct goals (gain a rank OR become no.1 great power OR obtain the required prestige).

- id=\"Enlightened Despot\"

name: Enlightened Despot
en:
{{Collapse list|All owned states (including colonies) need to have an [[Urban Center]] building in order to gain this achievement.|
* The Electric Streetlights [[production method]] requires {{icon|electricity|3=1}} in the state to be used. Therefore, releasing countries or trading away underdeveloped states can make this easier. Every owned state will need to have built at least one {{iconify|Power Plants|building|30px}}.
* Each level of industry generates 20 or 30 urbanization, and every 100 points of urbanization will generate 1 level of urbanization center, so building 4 or 5 industries everywhere will ensure that all states you own have a urbanization center (it is recommended to use the view list in production lens to build them, so that no province will be missed). Finally, switch the production method to electric streetlights.}}
* Since it is difficult to pass Autocracy in the mid to late game (as the {{icon|Landowners|3=1}} will likely be marginalized by this point), the player can instead deliberately provoke a revolutionary political movement and then resign/abdicate their ruler, then pick the last option that immediately enacts Autocracy.

- id=\"First Flight\"

name: First Flight
en:
{{technology|Military Aviation|text=link}} is an era 5 tech, so this is a long game. Is doable with any recognized country with a just somewhat manageable [[literacy]].

- id=\"Go West, Young Man\"

name: Go West, Young Man
en:
USA will claims on the states via the [[Manifest Destiny]] decision and the [[American_content#The_Oregon_Treaty|Oregon Treaty]] Journal Entry, and will later get a journal entry [[American_content#The_First_Transcontinental_Railway|''The First Transcontinental Railway'']], which can increase [[migration]] to those exact states, making the achievement fairly doable in any normal USA game. If the journal entry proves to be not enough, the ''Greener Grass Campaign'' edict should do the rest.

- id=\"Grander Colombia\"

name: Grander Colombia
en:
Forming {{flag|Federation of the Andes}} blocks the achievement
{{collapse list|{{flag|Colombia|New Granada}} is a good candidate to form {{flag|Gran Colombia}}|
* They can quickly annex or subjugate their neighbors, {{flag|Venezuela}} and {{flag|Ecuador}}. If you declare war on {{flag|Grão-Pará}} on Day 1, you can annex it before {{flag|Brazil}} can; while this does not help with the achievement directly, it does weaken Brazil, who is likely the greatest immediate threat. Additionally, once {{flag|Central America}} breaks up, its successors are easily annexed or subjugated. New Granada can also eventually sell the Panama Canal for £30k, giving a short-term boost to the economy.
* {{flag|Mexico}} is an good long-term trade partner and war ally for when the player starts expanding south. Similarly, the player should befriend {{flag|Great Britain}}, {{flag|France}}, and the {{flag|America|United States}} from the start, as they are otherwise likely to intervene in diplo plays during the early stages of expansion before the player has a large enough army to hold them off.
* When expanding southward, {{flag|Brazil}} is a major consideration and allying them will ease the process. Conquering {{flag|Argentina}}, {{flag|Chile}} and {{flag|Paraguay}} first is easier and allows for leaving the stronger {{flag|Peru}} and {{flag|Bolivia}} who typically unite as Peru-Bolivia for after.
* Finally, the player needs to conquer Guyana, held by three great powers. {{flag|Great Britain|British}} Guyana is the best to start with, as it has a land border with the state of Bolívar in Venezuela. Make sure to claim and naval invade the South Atlantic Islands (Falklands) also as those are part of the La Plata region. After that, {{flag|Netherlands|Dutch}} Guyana as it neighbors British Guyana, and finally {{flag|France|French}} Guyana. For all three Guyanas, a naval invasion is useful to bypass the  enemy forces on the land border and open a second, less guarded front. With the last Guyana, it can be worth it to trade an enemy war goal, in order to get the final piece of Guyana for the achievement; however be careful not to cede any territory from the required strategic regions, even just a treaty port. Alternatively, colonize/conquer states with British/French presence (outside the required regions and held by another nation) and use \"Trade States\".}}

- id=\"Habsburg Resurgence\"

name: Habsburg Resurgence
Hegemon
en:
{{collapse list|The final step requires having at least 40% of the world's population ruled by you or your subjects.|
* Although not a recommended nation in the select menu, {{flag|Great Britain}} by far is in the best position to attain this, as they start with 19% of the world's population due to controlling India, in addition to their position as #1 Great Power allowing them to skip straight to the final objective. 
* To cover the remaining population, focus on weakening {{flag|China}} via liberating countries and annexing their most populous states until they drop to Unrecognized Regional Power, after which they can be targeted with a diplomatic play to make them a protectorate.
* {{flag|China}} is also in a solid position to achieve this, as they already start with 1/3rd of the world's population, and merely transferring {{flag|East India}} from Britain would get them over the 40% mark. However, China would need to first modernize and catch up in technology to have any chance of winning a war against Great Britain.}}

- id=\"I am a Scandinavian\"

name: I am a Scandinavian
en:
Easiest to do as {{flag|Sweden}}, since you only need 3 more states and {{technology|Pan-nationalism|text=link}} society technology in order to form {{flag|Scandinavia}}. You should be able to easily overcome {{flag|Denmark}} and take the required states.

- id=\"I didn’t vote for Pedro\"

name: I didn’t vote for Pedro
en:
* Getting {{law|Universal Suffrage|text=link}} first allows for easier passage of further reforms. Your main opponents are the {{icon|Landowners|3=1}} and {{icon|Armed Forces|3=1}}, so you may want to start with reforms like {{law|Dedicated Police Force|text=link}} to weaken their influence.

{{icon|cotsb|w=24px}} Having any republican form of government will close the ''Magnanimous Monarch'' journal entry and block the ''Magnanimous'' achievement.

- id=\"Institutional\"

name: Institutional
en:
Easiest to do as {{flag|Netherlands}} since they start with {{law|Dedicated Police Force|text=link}} at level 1 and can immediately start upgrading it to level 5 with sufficient additional {{icon|bureaucracy|3=1}}.

- id=\"Inventive\"

name: Inventive
en:
* Increasing {{icon|innovation|3=1}} speeds up research.
* The following countries have the most technologies at the start already, giving them a technological advantage: [[Great Britain]], [[France]], [[USA]], [[Belgium]], [[Prussia]].
* Several [[companies]] can increase innovation generation, and Philips in particular increases max innovation investment
* {{icon|SoIb}} The {{principle|Advanced Research|3=1}} principle provides several advantages for research.

- id=\"Luxurious Luxembourg\"

name: Luxurious Luxembourg
en:
* Entering a large [[market]], such as {{flag|France}} or {{flag|Prussia}}'s, will allow you to specialise exclusively in the required industries without worrying much about pop needs or input resources. However to enter another market you will need to become independent of the {{flag|Netherlands}} or hope they join a large market. Acquiring another state beside Wallonia speeds things up considerably. You will have a decisive surplus of {{icon|authority|3=1}}, so you can freely use [[decrees]]; they help a lot.
* Having a high [[migration attraction]] is essential for employment, so multiculturalism helps significantly. Forming {{flag|United Netherlands}} or {{flag|Germany}} does not block this achievement.

- id=\"Manifest Mexico\"

name: Manifest Mexico
en:
The required states don't exactly match the strategic regions Great Plains and Pacific Coast. Even though the description does not mention it, if the USA does not exist, it counts for the achievement. Since the USA will not be able to complete ''The Oregon Border Dispute'' assuming the player maintains control of the states the USA gains claims on, a war with {{flag|Great Britain}} to conquer those states from them (potentially through liberating {{flag|Oregon}} or {{flag|Canada}} to lower the infamy costs) will likely be necessary.

- id=\"Mightier than the Sword\"

name: Mightier than the Sword
en:
During a diplomatic play means before war breaks out; it does not count if they give in to the demand before the play starts either.

- id=\"Minors, not Miners\"

name: Minors, not Miners
en:
Your overlord, {{flag|China|Great Qing}}, should provide enough troops for conquering minors. Improve relations to keep other majors from siding against you. Economic development is not hard in the {{flag|China|Great Qing}} market as there is a large supply of raw materials and non-discriminated labor (in patches before Qing has \"Closed Borders\").
Your name will change to \"Bo-Ni\" on full control of Borneo. - id=\"Muhammed Ali’s Ambition\"

name: Muhammed Ali’s Ambition
en:
It is very easy to make all Arabian minors your subjects before the truce with the {{flag|Turkey|Ottoman Empire}} expires. Start with a diplo play to make {{flag|Hedjaz}} a vassal, and continue with neighboring countries from there. If the Ottoman Empire joins in defense of an Arabian minor, you can take war reparations and liberate {{flag|Iraq}} or {{flag|Bulgaria}} to weaken them.

- id=\"Peccavi\"

name: Peccavi
en:
{{flag|Bahawalpur}} can be annexed on day 1 via the [[Colonial_Indies_content#Doctrine_of_Lapse_Invoked|Doctrine of Lapse]] interaction. {{flag|Sindh}} can be conquered day 1 with East India's starting armies. The Sikh Empire in {{flag|Punjab}} is a more capable foe, but should be manageable. If needed, offering an obligation to {{flag|Great Britain}} is usually enough to get them involved and defeat them immediately as well. Both states can be fully owned by 1837 this way.
The name of the achievement is Latin for \"I have sinned\" (a pun on \"Sindh\"). - id=\"Perkeletankki\"

name: Perkeletankki
en:
* {{icon|Tanks|3=1}} require the {{technology|Mobile Armor|text=link}} military technology, which is one of the final technologies you can unlock in the \"military\" tab, so be prepared for a long campaign. To produce one 100 units of tanks, Finland needs at least 5 {{iconify|Automotive Industries|building}} on the tank production method. It does not actually matter if there is any demand for tanks.
* Being independent is not a requirement for this achievement, so remaining a {{flag|Russia}}n subject can be advantageous, as it grants you protection and a larger market.
The name of the achievement is Finnish for \"Hell Tank\".

- id=\"Poor, Huddled Masses\"

name: Poor, Huddled Masses
en:
Should happen in any reasonably successful playthrough

- id=\"Poppydock\"
